name: Site Status Message
description: Displays a configurable site-wide banner message at the top of pages, with an optional read-more link and public/admin display scoping.
project_description:
This module displays a simple message on the top of all pages on your site which can be used as a notification or warning. It was completely inspired by the Drupal.org downtime message displayed in October 2013 before the update of Drupal.org from Drupal 6 to Drupal 7.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Highlight important information at the top of each page so users have no excuse to claim they have not seen your awesome message! 
 Add an optional link to display more information 
 Show on all pages of the site including Admin areas 
 HTML template so themers can't complain 
 Submodules included to enhance the features of this module including scheduling messages, changing the colour/status type, and external links for the more information page (D7 only currently)
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 The Drupal 7 version will work on any Drupal 7 site, with minimal configuration needed.

 The Drupal 8 version is still a release candidate and not fully tested yet. 

 The Drupal 9/10 version is a completely new rewrite and is ready for testing. (Feb 2023)
